name: a star outline morphs around drifting blobs
looks: A thin outline shape morphs slowly between a star and an organic blob, rotating gently, while several small dark blobs of different sizes drift loosely inside it under a goo filter, never quite settling.
build: metaball-morph: the outline resamples each shape to the same point count and interpolates on power3.inOut; the inner blobs sit under an feGaussianBlur plus feColorMatrix goo filter so they merge and separate smoothly as they drift.
sound: A soft wobble under the drift, a tick on each outline change.
prompt: Morph a thin outline shape slowly between a star and an organic blob while it rotates gently, with a handful of small dark blobs of different sizes drifting loosely inside it, merging and separating under a soft goo effect. Use it as a playful, abstract identity beat that never fully settles.
